_meta.purpose: arxiv_id -> 'owner/repo' mapping for theme-lineage GitHub stars enrichment.
_meta.rationale: Papers with Code shut down its API and data dumps in 2026; this curated map is the primary source. The theme builder falls back to GitHub Search by paper title for arxiv_ids not listed here.
guidelines: Prefer the OFFICIAL author-affiliated repo (e.g. facebookresearch/, google-research/, openai/, NVlabs/, microsoft/) over popular reimplementations.
When no clean official repo exists, pick the most-starred faithful reimplementation that the field treats as canonical.
Keep entries one-per-line so PRs are easy to review.
Validate by visiting https://github.com/<value> before adding.
Update when an official repo migrates (rare but possible).
